meta.title: Vlad Mihalachi — Software Engineer
meta.description: Vlad Mihalachi, Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft and maker of mybackhurts, sunnysays and Mister Pagliacci.
meta.imageAlt: Vlad Mihalachi, software engineer and maker, next to the VM orbit drawing from the site.

hero.title:
I build software
that earns its place.
hero.intro: I’m Vlad, a software engineer across the stack. I untangle things until they’re simple enough to explain.

work.title:
I like the messy part
before things click.
work.experience: I’m a Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft: 9+ years building software, the last 6+ there.
work.openSource: Off the clock, I read open-source code and chip in when I have something useful to add.

project.title:
My back hurts.
So I built an app.
project.description: gets you off the chair every 45 minutes for a few quick moves. If you let it, your webcam counts the reps.

sunnysays.title:
Then I built something
just for fun.
sunnysays.description: is a sunflower in your menu bar or tray that says something small a couple of times an hour. Tell it shh and it droops.
sunnysays.line1: A bee came by once. We nodded.
sunnysays.line2: I’ve been thinking about clouds. No conclusions yet.
sunnysays.line3: Photosynthesis is going great, thanks for asking.
sunnysays.line4: I think the desk is slightly tilted. Or I am.

pagliacci.title:
Now I’m building
a sad clown.
pagliacci.description: is a clown in your menu bar or tray who tells a short joke a couple of times an hour, sometimes with a beat before the punchline. Funny, and a little sad.
pagliacci.fact1: His own voice, in English and Italian

tools.title:
And the open-source
parts underneath.
tools.laching: is the plumbing under all three apps: reminders, quiet hours, and call detection without the camera.
tools.webling: is its web sibling, for small ASP.NET Core and Blazor sites behind Cloudflare.
tools.untranslated: fails the build when a Blazor page shows text nobody translated.

interests.title: Things that fascinate me
interests.mathsText: Patterns, proofs, and the quiet pleasure of an elegant solution.
interests.physicsText: How the universe holds together, and why it behaves the way it does.
interests.biologyText: Living systems are full of strange, practical solutions.

contact.title: Want to talk?
contact.text: I’m happy to talk about software, open source, or anything we still don’t fully understand.
